paper_metadata.title: Simultaneously enhancing the hot workability and room-temperature strength of Ti-6Al-4V alloy via adding Mo and Fe

evidence.quote: Two pieces of block samples with dimensions of 45 mm × 40 mm × 10 mm were cut from X0 and X2 alloy ingots, and then hot-rolled and hot-forged in the dual-phase region at about 70 °C below the β transus temperature of X0 and X2 alloys, respectively. The hot rolling reduction is about 80%, and the diameter of the rod after hot forging is 15 mm. After hot working, the samples were annealed at 700 °C for 1.5 h.
